hypothesis_1.note: title: TNFSF13 (APRIL) 'drives' excessive IgA production leading to immune complex deposition in IgA nephropathy; both steps are unsigned and the chain breaks between IgA production and IgA deposition

hypothesis_2.note: title: 'CFH deficiency ... exacerbating glomerular injury', so losing CFH worsens disease (neg); aspect severity from 'exacerbating glomerular injury', though the mechanism also speaks of 'disease progression'

hypothesis_3.note: title: CARD9 and ITGAX 'amplify' immune responses, 'driving progressive glomerulonephritis'; one claim per gene; the chain is three unlinked edges, neither gene's step reaching the last step's subject

findings.detail: No step, supporting_evidence or contradicting_evidence field cites anything and sources.json is empty, although eleven specialists (literature, gwas, uniprot, open_targets, ...) were available; run.json does not record whether any was called.
The budget asks for min_sources_per_hypothesis 2 and min_evidence_per_hypothesis 2, every hypothesis has 0, and the run was still accepted (abstention null).

Every step has polarity 'unknown' although the notes state directions for most of them ('promotes', 'exacerbates', 'enhance', 'drive'), so the structured chain carries no sign and the run yields no statement at all.
H1.1 ends at 'IgA production' and H1.2 starts at 'IgA immune complex deposition'; the nodes the mechanism names between them (galactose-deficient IgA1, immune complex formation) are never steps.

H2.1 ends at 'complement activation' and H2.2 starts at 'complement-mediated glomerular injury'; no step says complement activation causes glomerular injury, and the 'IgA deposits' of the title appear in no step.

H3 is three unlinked edges (CARD9 -> pro-inflammatory cytokine production, ITGAX -> antigen presentation and T cell activation, chronic glomerular inflammation -> IgAN); neither gene's object is the last step's subject.
The run gives no CURIE and no grounding_evidence for any of its 12 distinct labels; all 12 were grounded here, one split into two GO processes and 'IgA production' as a refinement.

The last steps name parts of the disease's own name as its cause: glomerular IgA deposition (H1.2) and chronic glomerular inflammation (H3.3, which is HP:0000099 Glomerulonephritis and what MONDO:0005342's definition says the disease is), so they restate IgA glomerulonephritis rather than link to it.
Two of three chains end with a generic glomerular-damage node -> IgA glomerulonephritis step that would fit any glomerulonephritis; nothing in those steps is specific to IgA nephropathy.
All three hypotheses are labelled confidence low and support speculative, which matches their having no citations: the labels are honest here.

The mechanism calls ITGAX (CD11c) 'a marker of dendritic cells and macrophages' that 'could present antigens', and the step note says it 'may be involved'; a cell-type marker is offered as a causal subject with a hedged step.
The object 'antigen presentation and T cell activation' joins two processes (GO:0019882, GO:0042110) in one node.
The notes invoke 'loss-of-function variants' of CFH and 'gain-of-function variants' of CARD9 without naming any variant or GWAS record, although a gwas specialist was available.
The falsification knocks out CARD9 and ITGAX together, so it cannot tell which of the two gene claims fails.

The description compares mesangial cells exposed to immune complexes from CFH-deficient patients with controls, but the stated perturbation is a CFH knockdown in mesangial cell culture: two different experiments.
DEFA4, OR4X1 and ZNF174 are left unexplained rather than forced into a hypothesis; three of seven genes get no mechanism.

The guide maps leads_to with unknown polarity to no_sign unless a cited text gives the direction, but defines no_sign as 'no direction anywhere'; these steps' own notes state a direction, so the two rules disagree (I followed the table row).
An unexpressed entry cannot name its grounded subject and object or the direction its prose states, so this run's grounding lives only in run_labels and none of its 7 steps reaches Lean.

No GO process for IgA production (isotype-specific immunoglobulin production); grounded as GO:0002377 immunoglobulin production refined to cell type CL:0000987 IgA plasma cell ('a plasma cell that secretes IgA').
No term for glomerular injury; 'complement-mediated glomerular injury' is grounded to HP:0100820 Glomerulopathy ('diseases affecting the glomeruli'), which is broader.

HP:6000668 Glomerular immune-complex deposition is defined as able to 'lead to glomerulonephritis', a direction for a step like H1.2, but the guide lets only cited texts sign a step and allows textbook quotes only in bridges, so it was not used.

MONDO:0005342 IgA glomerulonephritis is defined only as 'Inflammation of a specific segment of glomeruli within the kidney', which omits IgA, so no definition could bridge IgA deposition to it even as a feature.
With no statements every claim reports 'no route'; the report cannot tell a run whose steps are all unsigned from one whose chains are disconnected, though here both hold.
The title says 'exacerbating glomerular injury' (severity) and the mechanism 'disease progression' (progression); a claim takes one aspect, so severity was chosen.

The falsification knocks out Tnfsf13 in a 'mouse model of IgA nephropathy', so the disease is already present, and reads glomerular IgA deposition (the H1.2 subject) and 'disease severity'; it tests severity, not the risk the title claims, and never reads the IgA production of H1.1.

The run types 'IgA immune complex deposition', 'complement-mediated glomerular injury' and 'chronic glomerular inflammation' as processes; no GO process fits any of them, and they are grounded here as HP phenotypes (HP:0000794, HP:0100820, HP:0000099).

audit.after: hypothesis-agent: the H1 falsification runs in a mouse that already has IgAN and reads IgA deposition and 'disease severity', while the claim is risk
audit.reason: run.json hypothesis_1 falsification.description: 'In a mouse model of IgA nephropathy, knockout of Tnfsf13 would be expected to reduce glomerular IgA deposition and ameliorate kidney injury. If knockout does not reduce IgA deposition or disease severity, the hypothesis is falsified.' The curator recorded falsification problems for H2 and H3 but not H1.

audit.after: hypothesis-agent: three subjects typed 'process' by the run are phenotypes with no GO process
audit.reason: run.json gives kind 'process' to 'IgA immune complex deposition', 'complement-mediated glomerular injury' and 'chronic glomerular inflammation'; terms.py finds no GO process for any of them and the curator grounded all three as HP phenotypes without noting the change of kind.
